description: This Java class 'DeveloperUtils' provides utility methods for debugging and development purposes within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It includes functions for creating memory dumps, managing tracing (start, stop, check if started), retrieving application details, and handling tracing preferences.

classes.name: DeveloperUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing debugging and development tools such as memory dump creation, tracing control, and app info retrieval.

methods.name: createMemoryDump
methods.description: Creates a heap dump file for debugging purposes, stored on external storage.

methods.name: hasTracingRequested
methods.description: Checks if tracing has been requested via shared preferences.

methods.name: setTracingRequested
methods.description: Sets the tracing request status in shared preferences.

methods.name: startTracing
methods.description: Starts method tracing and marks tracing as started.

methods.name: hasTracingStarted
methods.description: Returns whether tracing has been started.

methods.name: stopTracing
methods.description: Stops method tracing and handles potential exceptions.

methods.name: getTraceFile
methods.description: Returns the file object for the trace output.

methods.name: getAppDetails
methods.description: Returns a string with application name, version, install time, and first install info.
